about: Input tokens of the whole experiment, each kind of user apart, read from the repository's evidence files. Nothing here was measured by this script.
unit: input tokens as the host's records give them with each reply; a token is counted each time it is read, cache reads included

reviewers.which: the first phase's review agents, and the lanes of the development rounds whose work was to attack or review and not to build

not_measured_and_in_no_figure: the session that wrote the experiment and started the others (the authoring session), outside the first phase's stage windows
what an orchestrating session read between stages (setting up, preparing and closing a stage, saving)
the orchestrating sessions of the two development rounds
the orchestrator during a security gate stage

counted_against_the_limit.what: agents, reviewers and development agents: the definition the limit has had since the first phase

everything_measured.what: agents, reviewers, development agents and the measured part of the orchestrators

stages_that_ran_and_are_in_no_figure.why: the stage was not closed, so the scripts measured neither its agents nor its orchestrator
